RESULT 08/07/26

✅ Implementation: Search Post Updates (Description & Include)

This document describes the public API contract for the new POTD broadcast list endpoint.

The original GET /notification/list-broadcast endpoint is unchanged.

Endpoint

GET /notification/list-potd

Headers

Name Required Example Description
Authorization Yes Bearer <token> User token.
ec No false When true, returns the encrypted response format used by existing broadcast APIs.

Query Parameters

Name Required Example Description
type Yes bookmark Allowed values: bookmark, posts.
page No 1 Page number. Defaults to 1.
limit No 10 Page size. Defaults to 10.
search No bali Searches broadcast title, message, slug, plus folder name for bookmarks or post description for posts.
include No title,location,bookmark Comma-separated response fields. Allowed values: broadcast_type, title, messages, slug, location, post, user, bookmark.
sp No false Support mode. Only support accounts can use sp=true.

Get POTD Bookmarks

curl -G "{{base_url}}/notification/list-potd" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "ec: false" \
  --data-urlencode "type=bookmark" \
  --data-urlencode "page=1" \
  --data-urlencode "limit=10" \
  --data-urlencode "sp=false"

Success response:

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "valid": true,
    "version": 0,
    "messages": "List POTD Broadcast",
    "broadcast": [
      {
        "broadcast_type": "bookmark",
        "title": "Holiday Places",
        "messages": "Featured bookmark folder",
        "slug": "holiday-places",
        "location": {
          "lat": -8.409518,
          "lng": 115.188919
        },
        "bookmark": {
          "total": 5,
          "thumbnail": "sample.jpg",
          "name": "Holiday Places"
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}

Get POTD Posts

curl -G "{{base_url}}/notification/list-potd" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "ec: false" \
  --data-urlencode "type=posts" \
  --data-urlencode "page=1" \
  --data-urlencode "limit=10" \
  --data-urlencode "sp=false"

Success response:

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "valid": true,
    "version": 0,
    "messages": "List POTD Broadcast",
    "broadcast": [
      {
        "broadcast_type": "post",
        "title": "Alun Alun Subang",
        "messages": "Regency",
        "slug": null,
        "location": {
          "latitude": -6.569922,
          "longitude": 107.760681
        },
        "post": {
          "slug_post": "cc9d4c4a3a5-2024052131022734",
          "panorama_preview": "preview.jpg",
          "post_type": "panorama",
          "thumbnail": "thumbnail.jpg",
          "animation": true,
          "animation_filter": null,
          "little_planet": false,
          "little_planet_filter": null,
          "panorama_quality": null,
          "pending": false
        },
        "user": {
          "avatar": "avatar.jpg",
          "fullname": "Mang JM",
          "username": "mc"
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}

Include Filtering

Use include to return only the fields needed by the client.

Allowed fields:

broadcast_type,title,messages,slug,location,post,user,bookmark

Invalid fields are ignored. The id field is always denied by Functions.GetValidIncludes.

Bookmark include example:

curl -G "{{base_url}}/notification/list-potd" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "ec: false" \
  --data-urlencode "type=bookmark" \
  --data-urlencode "include=title,location,bookmark"

Response:

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "valid": true,
    "version": 0,
    "messages": "List POTD Broadcast",
    "broadcast": [
      {
        "title": "Holiday Places",
        "location": {
          "lat": -8.409518,
          "lng": 115.188919
        },
        "bookmark": {
          "total": 5,
          "thumbnail": "sample.jpg",
          "name": "Holiday Places"
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}

Posts include example:

curl -G "{{base_url}}/notification/list-potd" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "ec: false" \
  --data-urlencode "type=posts" \
  --data-urlencode "include=title,location,post"

Response:

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "valid": true,
    "version": 0,
    "messages": "List POTD Broadcast",
    "broadcast": [
      {
        "title": "Alun Alun Subang",
        "location": {
          "latitude": -6.569922,
          "longitude": 107.760681
        },
        "post": {
          "slug_post": "cc9d4c4a3a5-2024052131022734",
          "panorama_preview": "preview.jpg",
          "post_type": "panorama",
          "thumbnail": "thumbnail.jpg",
          "animation": true,
          "animation_filter": null,
          "little_planet": false,
          "little_planet_filter": null,
          "panorama_quality": null,
          "pending": false
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}

Search Examples

Bookmark search:

curl -G "{{base_url}}/notification/list-potd" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "ec: false" \
  --data-urlencode "type=bookmark" \
  --data-urlencode "search=bali"

Post search:

curl -G "{{base_url}}/notification/list-potd" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "ec: false" \
  --data-urlencode "type=posts" \
  --data-urlencode "search=panorama"

Encrypted Response

Request:

curl -G "{{base_url}}/notification/list-potd" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "ec: true" \
  --data-urlencode "type=bookmark" \
  --data-urlencode "page=1" \
  --data-urlencode "limit=10"

Response shape:

{
  "cry": "<encrypted_payload>",
  "ls": 1751983200,
  "messages": "List POTD Broadcast"
}

Error Responses

Invalid or missing type:

{
  "statusCode": 400,
  "data": {
    "valid": false,
    "error": "Bad Request",
    "messages": "Invalid type"
  }
}

Unauthorized:

{
  "statusCode": 401,
  "data": {
    "valid": false,
    "error": "Unauthorized",
    "messages": "Unauthorized"
  }
}

Internal server error:

{
  "statusCode": 500,
  "data": {
    "valid": false,
    "error": "Internal Server Error",
    "messages": "Internal Server Error"
  }
}

Notes

  • The response does not include a coordinate field.
  • The top-level data key remains broadcast, matching ListBroadcast.
  • For type=bookmark, location follows the stored shape of folder_bookmark.location.
  • For type=posts, location follows the stored shape of posts.location_post.
  • When include is empty, each item returns the full default shape.

This document describes the implementation details for the POTD broadcast list task.

Task Summary

Create a new POTD API without overwriting the original broadcast list API.

Requirements:

  • Keep ListBroadcast unchanged.
  • Add a new endpoint for POTD list data.
  • Split POTD data from the start by type=posts or type=bookmark.
  • Keep the response shape close to ListBroadcast.
  • Add location.
  • Do not add a separate coordinate field.
  • Add include filtering through Functions.GetValidIncludes.

Files Changed

File Change
src/Action/V1/Broadcast/ListPotdBroadcast.go New action for POTD broadcast list.
src/Controllers/V1/BroadcastControllers.go Added ListPotdBroadcast controller wrapper.
src/Routes/V1/BroadcastRoutes.go Added GET /notification/list-potd.
api-collection/Panorra API Feeds/Broadcast/List POTD.yml Added Bruno API collection item.
docs/API/list-potd-broadcast-api.md Added API contract documentation.
docs/API/list-potd-broadcast-implementation.md Added implementation documentation.

Routing

Route file:

notification.Get("/list-potd", Controllers.ListPotdBroadcast)

Controller wrapper:

func ListPotdBroadcast(c *fiber.Ctx) error {
    return BroadcastAction.ListPotdBroadcast(c)
}

Query Flow

The action reads:

  • type
  • page
  • limit
  • search
  • include
  • sp
  • ec

The type query parameter is required.

Allowed values:

  • posts
  • bookmark

Invalid or missing values return:

return Functions.ErrorResponse(c, 400, fiber.ErrBadRequest.Message, "Invalid type")

Include Filtering

The action supports an optional include query parameter.

Allowed fields:

allowedFields := []string{
    "broadcast_type",
    "title",
    "messages",
    "slug",
    "location",
    "post",
    "user",
    "bookmark",
}

Validation uses the existing helper:

validFields := Functions.GetValidIncludes(include, allowedFields)

The result is converted into a map for fast checks while mapping each response item:

includeMap := map[string]bool{}
for _, field := range validFields {
    includeMap[field] = true
}
shouldInclude := func(field string) bool {
    return include == "" || includeMap[field]
}

Behavior:

  • Empty include returns the full default response shape.
  • Non-empty include returns only valid requested fields.
  • Unknown fields are ignored.
  • id is denied by Functions.GetValidIncludes.
  • Bookmark count and thumbnail lookup only run when bookmark is included, reducing unnecessary DB work.

Bookmark Query

When type=bookmark, the query joins only the bookmark-related tables:

  • broadcast b
  • folder_bookmark fb
  • users u

Main filters:

  • b.post_type = 'bookmark'
  • b.folder_id IS NOT NULL
  • fb.is_published = true

Owner data comes from:

u.id = fb.user_id

Location source:

fb.location

Search checks:

  • b.messages
  • b.title
  • b.slug
  • fb.name

Posts Query

When type=posts, the query joins only the post-related tables:

  • broadcast b
  • posts p
  • users u

Main filters:

  • b.post_type = 'post'
  • b.post_id IS NOT NULL

Owner data comes from:

u.id = p.user_id

Location source:

p.location_post AS location

Search checks:

  • b.messages
  • b.title
  • b.slug
  • p.description

Shared Behavior

Both types reuse the same behavior as ListBroadcast where applicable:

  • Auth check with UserFunctions.UserDatas.
  • Support account check with sp=true.
  • Deactivated user filtering from Redis key PREFIX_deactive_users_ec.
  • Blocked user filtering from Redis key PREFIX_blocked_users_ec_<encrypt>.
  • Pagination through page, limit, and offset.
  • HTML unescape for title and messages.
  • JSON unmarshal for JSON fields such as location, panorama_quality, and filters.
  • Optional encrypted response when request header ec is true.

Response Mapping

The response envelope remains:

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "valid": true,
    "version": 0,
    "messages": "List POTD Broadcast",
    "broadcast": []
  }
}

For type=bookmark, each item includes:

  • broadcast_type
  • title
  • messages
  • slug
  • location
  • bookmark

For type=posts, each item includes:

  • broadcast_type
  • title
  • messages
  • slug
  • location
  • post
  • user

When include is present, the item is filtered after all required parsing and shaping:

GET /notification/list-potd?type=bookmark&include=title,location,bookmark

Response item:

{
  "title": "Holiday Places",
  "location": {
    "lat": -8.409518,
    "lng": 115.188919
  },
  "bookmark": {
    "total": 5,
    "thumbnail": "sample.jpg",
    "name": "Holiday Places"
  }
}

Why Joins Are Split By Type

The first implementation used shared joins for both post and bookmark paths. The query was then updated to split joins by type.

Reason:

  • Avoid joining unused tables.
  • Make the SQL easier to read.
  • Keep search conditions aligned with the selected type.
  • Prevent bookmark-only filters from affecting post results, and post-only search from affecting bookmark results.

Verification

Compile and package verification:

go test ./...

Expected result:

?    panorra-api-go/src/Action/V1/Broadcast    [no test files]
...

The latest run completed successfully with exit code 0.

Description

  • Add params type posts/bookmark.
  • Item add object: coordinate ([lat, long]), location.

Design notes (from brainstorm 2026-07-08)

Decision: two separate endpoints (not one unified type handler). type = posts | bookmark is the frontend tab selector that picks which endpoint to call.

A1 — Posts tab: extend most-popular-post (/v1/posts/most-popular-post, -feed, sl/ twins)

  • Add location_post, location_name to the views_timeline_post select (feed variant currently omits location_post).
  • Each item gains location (from location_name) and coordinate parsed from location_post JSONB (latitude/longitude). coordinate = null when the post has no location; map skips nulls.

A2 — Bookmarks tab: new list endpoint (e.g. GET /v1/posts/potd-bookmark)

  • Support-published folder = a row in the broadcast table with that folder_id (existing pattern, no new column).
  • Returns the existing folder-card shape (name, slug, thumbnails[4], total-bookmark counter, potd, is_published) plus location + coordinate.
  • Apply the standard blocked-user / blocked-post / deactivated-user filters.

Open questions

  1. Coordinate as object {lat,lng} (recommended) vs array [lat, long] as written above?
  2. Folder map coordinate: one representative point (recommended v1) vs array of the folder's post pins?
  3. Endpoint naming/path (potd-bookmark under posts/ or broadcast/?).
  4. Do the bookmark cards need the slim (sl/) + ec encrypted variants?
  5. Role: allow viewer for the bookmark list, or user only?

RESULT 09/07/26

✅ Implementation: DetailBroadcastPost Location Fields

Overview

This document outlines the implementation details for updating the DetailBroadcastPost API endpoint to include location_name and location_post inside the returned post object.

File Modified

  • src/Action/V1/Broadcast/DetailBroadcastPost.go

Technical Details

The endpoint builds the broadcast detail response from a manual GORM query against the posts, broadcast, and users tables.

The update is additive and keeps the existing response structure intact. The new location fields are returned under broadcast.post, because the location data belongs to the post being broadcast.

Query Update

The select clause now retrieves the post location fields from the posts table:

 Select(`
 	b.messages, b.title, b.post_type as broadcast_type,
 	p.slug as slug_post, p.panorama_preview, p.thumbnail, p.post_type,
+	p.location_name, p.location_post,
 	u.username, u.fullname, u.avatar
 `)

Response Mapping Update

The post object now includes location_name and location_post:

 post := map[string]interface{}{
 	"slug_post":        broadcast["slug_post"],
 	"panorama_preview": broadcast["panorama_preview"],
 	"post_type":        broadcast["post_type"],
 	"thumbnail":        broadcast["thumbnail"],
+	"location_name":    broadcast["location_name"],
+	"location_post":    broadcast["location_post"],
 }

Response Impact

Before this update, broadcast.post only returned post identity and media preview fields.

After this update, broadcast.post also returns:

{
  "location_name": "Location name value",
  "location_post": {
    "latitude": "0.000000",
    "longitude": "0.000000"
  }
}

Validation

  • Ran go test ./src/Action/V1/Broadcast
  • Result: package compiled successfully, with no test files present.

Notes

No database migration is required because both fields already exist on the posts table and are only being selected and mapped into the API response.

Description

  • New feature: detail POTD.
  • Lat/long for map.

issues.main_description_html:
RESULT 09/07/26

✅ Implementation: ListBroadcastBookmark Location Fields

Overview

This document outlines the implementation details for updating the ListBroadcastBookmark API endpoint to include location_name and location_post in each returned bookmark post item.

Files Modified

  • src/Action/V1/Broadcast/ListBroadcastBookmark.go
  • src/Models/BroadcastModel.go

Technical Details

The ListBroadcastBookmark endpoint retrieves a broadcast bookmark folder, loads the related bookmarked posts, and maps each post into the BroadcastBookmark response model.

The update is additive. It keeps the existing response shape and adds location fields directly to each item in the bookmarks array, because the location data belongs to each bookmarked post.

Model Update

The BroadcastBookmark struct now includes LocationName and LocationPost fields:

 type BroadcastBookmark struct {
 	SlugPost           *string             `json:"slug_post"`
 	PostType           *string             `json:"post_type"`
 	Thumbnail          *string             `json:"thumbnail"`
+	LocationName       *string             `json:"location_name"`
+	LocationPost       *postgres.Jsonb     `json:"location_post" gorm:"type:jsonb;default:'{}'"`
 	Animation          *bool               `json:"animation"`
 	AnimationFilter    *postgres.Jsonb     `json:"animation_filter" gorm:"type:jsonb;default:'{}'"`
 }

Query Update

The post query now selects the location fields from the posts table:

 Select(`
 	p.slug as slug_post, p.thumbnail, p.panorama_quality, p.post_type, p.animation,
 	p.animation_filter, p.little_planet, p.little_planet_filter, p.pending,
-	p.panorama, p.panorama_preview, u.avatar, u.fullname, u.username
+	p.panorama, p.panorama_preview, p.location_name, p.location_post,
+	u.avatar, u.fullname, u.username
 `)

Response Impact

Each item in data.bookmarks now includes:

{
  "location_name": "Location name value",
  "location_post": {
    "latitude": "0.000000",
    "longitude": "0.000000"
  }
}

Validation

  • Ran go test ./src/Action/V1/Broadcast
  • Result: package compiled successfully, with no test files present.

Notes

No database migration is required. The endpoint only reads existing posts.location_name and posts.location_post fields and exposes them in the API response.
